cases.name: lif
cases.title: LIF, exponential current synapses
cases.note: Both integrate the membrane and the synaptic currents exactly over each step.

cases.name: cond
cases.title: LIF, conductance synapses
cases.note: sparx holds each conductance at its exact mean over the step, a second-order scheme; NEST integrates adaptively to within 1e-9 mV of the truth.

cases.name: brian2
cases.title: LIF, conductance synapses
cases.note: With hold="start" sparx holds the conductance at its value at the start of the step, as Brian2 does, and counts refractoriness one step shorter, as Brian2 does.

cases.name: izhikevich
cases.title: Izhikevich, regular spiking
cases.note: Run op by op in float64 with order="nest", it is NEST's run to the last bit.
